editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: Diagram-design, developed by Cathryn Lavery, includes 29 different editorial diagram types prepared for the artificial intelligence-supported coding tool Claude Code. This library cleanly presents complex diagrams directly using HTML and scalable vector graphics (SVG) instead of standard diagramming tools.

items.title: macro-inc/macro
items.summary: Macro is a workspace that combines business tools such as email, chat, documents and task management with a common artificial intelligence memory. Developed with the Rust language, this platform connects different workflows in a single interface.

items.title: hugohe3/ppt-master
items.summary: Python-based ppt-master is an artificial intelligence tool that converts documents or topics into editable presentation files (PowerPoint). The software allows users to use their own templates, turning text into professional presentations with native shapes, transition effects, animations and data-driven graphics.

items.title: infiniflow/ragflow
items.summary: RAGFlow is an open source fetch-based generation (RAG) engine that creates a context layer for large language models (LLM). It aims to improve data processing and accuracy of responses by combining advanced RAG techniques with agent capabilities.

items.title: NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard
items.summary: Developed by NVIDIA, Switchyard is a high-performance artificial intelligence inference engine written in Rust language. It offers an optimized runtime environment to run large language models (LLM) efficiently on different hardware infrastructures.

items.title: ZuodaoTech/everyone-can-use-english
items.summary: Everyone-can-use-english is an open source educational project that supports the English learning process with a structured curriculum. It offers practical methods and study resources for users who want to improve their language skills.

items.title: smicallef/spiderfoot
items.summary: SpiderFoot is a tool that automates open source intelligence (OSINT) collection for threat intelligence and attack surface mapping processes. This Python-based software accelerates security analysis by collecting data about target systems.

items.title: localsend/localsend
items.summary: LocalSend is an open source application that allows file sharing between different operating systems. It creates a platform-independent alternative to the AirDrop feature offered by Apple devices.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2
items.summary: LTX-2, developed by Lightricks, is an artificial intelligence model (generative model) that produces audio and video. This package provides the necessary Python tools to run the model's inference processes and fine-tune it using the low-order adaptation (LoRA) method.

items.title: embabel/embabel-agent
items.summary: Embabel is a framework designed to develop artificial intelligence agents running on the Java Virtual Machine (JVM). This structure, written in Kotlin, facilitates the integration of generative AI capabilities in enterprise software ecosystems.

items.title: cactus-compute/needle
items.summary: Developed by Cactus Compute, Needle offers a 14 MB foundation model that can run on small hardware such as phones, wearable devices and robots. This lightweight structure aims to run artificial intelligence applications locally on edge devices with limited processing power.

items.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
items.summary: Network security tool Tailscale found that a 16-year-old SQLite write-ahead log reset error was at the root of the database corruption. The company eliminated the data integrity risk by releasing the update that fixed this technical problem.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 is a new language model available through the OpenRouter platform that provides access to multi-modal AI models. This model aims to demonstrate high performance in complex logical inference and coding tasks.

items.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
items.summary: Artificial intelligence tools reduce the workspace of mid-level software developers by automating entry-level tasks in software development processes. This change brings with it a new workforce structure that allows companies to achieve higher efficiency with fewer senior engineers.

items.title: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
items.summary: It is being discussed that vehicle tracking searches made through automatic license plate readers should be subject to a legal search warrant on the grounds of personal privacy. The focus is on the risks posed by the uncontrolled use of data collected by these systems on individuals' freedom of movement.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B
items.summary: Developed by Alibaba, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a large language model focused on text generation. This model, shared on the Hugging Face platform, is used in various natural language processing tasks with its structure trained on large data sets.

items.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
items.summary: EvoX Genesis defines software projects as persistent and recursive worlds, ensuring a continuous development process despite the limited lifespan of artificial intelligence agents. This approach maintains the software itself as a centralized structure, allowing local coding agents to progress the project with ad-hoc tasks.

items.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
items.summary: OpenART is an open-ended testing environment developed to evaluate the cumulative risks of artificial intelligence agents in long-term workflows. Unlike traditional static benchmark tests, it aims to detect vulnerabilities (red teaming) in a scalable way by simulating the interactions of agents on a shared situation.

items.title: AtlasVLA: Persistent World-Ego State Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: AtlasVLA is a Vision-Language-Action model framework that enables robots to remember objects out of view and task progress. This method allows robotic systems to overcome the limitation of instantaneous response and manage long-term and complex tasks more consistently.

items.title: Self-Geometry: GT-Free and Plug-and-Play Test-Time Adaptation for Geometrically Consistent 3D Vision Foundation Models
items.summary: Self-Geometry is a method that eliminates geometric inconsistencies in data such as depth and camera position produced by vision foundation models without requiring additional training during the testing phase. This approach makes the three-dimensional outputs of models more consistent, without the need for traditional methods that create complex computational costs.

items.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
items.summary: Large language models have difficulty maintaining logical consistency despite user interventions in interactive storytelling. Developed by researchers, NCP-Bench offers a standard evaluation framework to measure the long-term narrative integrity of these models.

items.title: I hate packaging my software for Linux
items.summary: Software developers face serious compatibility issues in the process of packaging applications due to the diversity of Linux distributions. Different system requirements and package formats complicate developers' deployment processes, leading to loss of time.

items.title: Guide to (not) fucking up QR codes
items.summary: The use of QR codes involves technical details that require attention in terms of security and accessibility. To reduce the risks of faulty design and misdirection, the visual clarity of the codes and connection security need to be verified.

A presentation preparation program that allows you to present information in visual slides.
Artificial intelligence models trained with huge data that can understand human language and produce text.
A method that allows artificial intelligence to extract information from your current and private documents while producing answers.
The process of a trained artificial intelligence producing an answer to a new question using the information it has learned.
The time during which a software is run on the computer and actively performs its task.
A method of collecting and analyzing information from publicly available sources on the Internet.
Artificial intelligence that can create new content that it has not seen before, from scratch using the patterns it has learned.
